meta.question: on Aircraft (final, seeds 1-3, K=29), are the images where the MaskedKD student loses more non-target shape than Rollout the same images where the MaskedKD-masked teacher loses more non-target shape?
meta.method: per image non-target KL(full teacher || student) after held-out temperature scaling and non-target KL(full teacher || teacher on the 29 patches the run's own final student selects); paired MaskedKD - Rollout differences; Spearman across images with image bootstrap; seed t CI
